svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turn to 64 mm diameter x 60 mm long; face both ends square and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: parallel within 0.1 mm. Chamfer the outer edges 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both end faces: centre drill, drill 10.2 mm 27 mm deep and tap

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M12 x 1.75 to 24 mm deep. The two holes do not meet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spanner flats: mill two flats 55 mm across, 17 mm long, starting

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 mm above the bottom face, below the sensor pad.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The top face takes every hammer blow: leave it flat and smooth.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: both rod studs screw in to their shoulders with no thread

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: locker, tightened with a 55 mm spanner on the anvil and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rod flats or T-handle. The clamp collar butts the bottom face;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the sensor pad and band clamp onto its side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both rods seat on their shoulders with no rock; the anvil

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: spins true on the rod within 0.2 mm.
